text:
Leah Ramos: Notifying CS team — onboarding webhooks returning 401/403 in EU region after scheduled key rotation. ~120 tenants affected; spikes started ~02:10 UTC. Opening thread to coordinate customer comms.
Noah Kim: Any root cause yet?
Priya Desai: Preliminary: key rotation didn't trigger webhook-proxy reload in eu-central, some proxies signed with stale key. Cached tokens expired causing 4xxs.
Sam Wu: Mitigation: rolled webhook-proxy with forced reload + restarted onboarding-workers in eu-central. Retry queue processed; most tenants recovered.
Leah Ramos: Need two messages: brief status for all affected + tailored message for top 20 high-touch accounts. Suggest office hours for high-touch tomorrow 13:00 UTC.
Noah Kim: Agreed. Compensation suggestion: 10% onboarding credit + 1:1 enablement for verified failures.
Priya Desai: Timeline for comms: detection 02:10 UTC -> deploy 02:18 UTC -> retries caught up 02:45 UTC -> monitoring normal 03:10 UTC. I'll prepare 3-line RCA + logs.
Sam Wu: Example logs for comms:
```
2026-03-23T02:12:09Z webhook-proxy WARN signature_mismatch tenant=tenant-209
2026-03-23T02:18:30Z control-plane INFO trigger rolling-restart eu-central
2026-03-23T02:33:05Z onboarding-worker INFO replay_success tenant=tenant-209
```
Noah Kim: Finance okayed credits up to $4k/account for verified high-touch impacts. Please tag >$500 cases.
Leah Ramos: Action items: Priya draft RCA + logs; Noah compile impacted-account list; Sam prepare office hours invite and hotfix PR link; I'll draft customer templates and loop legal/finance.
incident-bot: Alert resolved — onboarding-webhook-4xx back to baseline at 3098766600.
Leah Ramos: We'll post RCA to #postmortems after office hours and include follow-ups. Drafts in GDoc: https://docs.internal/redwood/cs/onboard-auth-summary-3098765432
Leah Ramos: Closing this thread for now — will update with RCA link. :white_check_mark:
